## Hypothesis

H1: People with lower perceived social class will have more collectivist attitudes. 

H2: People who value gender equality will report higher overall romantic love with their partner.

```{r load package}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)

```

## Load the processed data

```{r loadData}
#load processed data
h1_data <- read.csv("data/processed_data/LRpractice_h1.csv")

h2_data <- read.csv("data/processed_data/LRpractice_h2.csv")
```

## H1 - RainCloud Plot and Boxplot

```{r H1Box and H1Rain}

h1FigureBox <- ggplot(data = h1_data,
                       aes(x = cot_class,
                           y = collect_avg,
                           fill = cot_class)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Self-Reported Social Class",
       y = "Average Belief in Collectivism",
       fill = "Social Class",
       title = "Average Belief in Collectivism by Self-Reported Social Class") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

h1FigureBox

h1FigureRain <- ggplot(data = h1_data,
                       aes(x = cot_class,
                           y = collect_avg,
                           fill = cot_class)) +
  geom_rain(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Self-Reported Social Class",
       y = "Average Belief in Collectivism",
       fill = "Social Class",
       title = "Average Belief in Collectivism by Self-Reported Social Class") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  
h1FigureRain

#

```


## H2 - Scatter Plots

```{r H2Scatter and Regression Line}
#Scatter Plot with regression line and jitter - looks a bit wonky bc there's so much data!
h2FigureScatter <- ggplot(data = h2_data,
                       aes(x = gen_eq_avg,
                           y = love_avg
                           )) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0.04, alpha = 0.04, size = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Average Belief in Gender Equality",
       y = "Average Experience of Overall Romantic Love",
       title = "Experience of Overall Romantic Love by Belief in Gender Equality") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

h2FigureScatter

```


## Save figures

```{r saveFigures}
#Run after creating the plots. Save PNG files in the project's figures folder.
ggsave("figures/H1_Rain_LR.png", plot = h1FigureRain,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300) 
ggsave("figures/H2_Line_LR.png", plot = h2FigureScatter,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
